If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.

Raw hex address 0x524fc6 assigned to bare local `uVar12`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `uVar12` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.
